name: @projexlight/sdk-resource-registry
summary: P10/E5 infrastructure resource ownership registry (Architecture v3.2 §11A.8 + OC-12). Enforces a no-owner-no-resource rule: every infra resource (terraform module, cloud account, network zone, etc.) MUST carry an accountable owner and an approver, so a platform.resource_registry row cannot exist without both owner and approved_by. Surfaces a thin read API ("who owns what") to the admin app, a register/upsert endpoint used by GitOps sync, and a reconciler that quarantines registered-but-expired resources and raises ownership alerts for live-but-unregistered orphans, emitting resource_registry.quarantined.v1 audit events.

endpoints.description: List/filter ownership records for the admin "who owns what" surface, by owner, status, environment, resource_type or team; paginated (default 100, max 500).
Fetch the single ownership record for a resource_id; 404 when no registry row exists.
Register or upsert an owned resource for GitOps sync; requires resource_id, resource_type, environment, owner and approved_by, and clears any prior quarantine (status back to 'registered').

events.name: resource_registry.quarantined.v1
events.description: Emitted by the reconciler when a resource is quarantined — reason 'expired' (registered but past expires_at) or 'orphan' (live resource with no registry row).

models.description: One row per infra resource keyed by resource_id (PK), carrying NOT NULL owner + approved_by (no-owner-no-resource), terraform/cloud/network provenance, optional expires_at, and a registered|quarantined status with quarantine_reason.

scenarios.title: Register an owned resource from GitOps sync
scenarios.when_to_use: When a GitOps/terraform reconciler applies infra and must record the accountable owner and approver so the resource is not treated as an orphan on the next reconcile pass.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Upserts the platform.resource_registry row (ON CONFLICT (resource_id) DO UPDATE), sets status back to 'registered' and clears quarantine_reason, returning the persisted record. Omitting owner or approved_by throws (no-owner-no-resource).

scenarios.title: Look up who owns a resource by id
scenarios.when_to_use: When the admin app or an incident responder needs the accountable owner/approver and provenance for a specific resource_id.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Returns the ResourceRegistryRecord for the resource_id, or null when no row exists (the GET /api/resources/:resource_id route maps that null to a 404).

scenarios.title: List quarantined resources for orphan review
scenarios.when_to_use: When reviewing the reconciler's output — e.g. surfacing all quarantined resources in an environment so an operator can re-register or tear them down.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Returns up to 50 registry rows in prod with status 'quarantined', ordered by updated_at DESC, each carrying quarantine_reason ('expired' or 'orphan') for triage.

scenarios.title: Reconcile live state against the registry
scenarios.when_to_use: When running the scheduled GitOps reconciler against observed cloud/terraform state to quarantine expired resources and flag orphans that lack a registry row.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Idempotently quarantines any registered-but-expired rows and identifies live resource_ids missing from the registry as orphans; each transition emits a resource_registry.quarantined.v1 audit event.

compliance_posture.notes: Supports SOC2 change-management and accountability controls: the NOT NULL owner + approved_by columns enforce that no infra resource exists without a named owner and approver, and every quarantine transition emits an append-only resource_registry.quarantined.v1 audit event via sdk-audit. Rows carry data_classification and network_zone hints for downstream data-handling review but hold infra metadata only (no end-user PII).
